pain: Without a versioned entry format and digest chain, a changed, reordered or truncated history cannot be detected.
who: HOME's trusted internal consumers: Collectors that append Activity Events and Projections that replay them.
done_when: Entry format v1 holds formatVersion, sequence, entryType, previousDigest and payload, and entryDigest is lowercase hex SHA-256 of its RFC 8785 canonical JSON excluding the digest itself.
Committed fixtures include the RFC 8785 test vectors and synthetic ledger entries whose expected digests were produced outside the package; tests read them and never regenerate them.

verifyHistory returns a typed IntegrityFailure for each of sequence_gap, unsupported_format, previous_digest_mismatch, entry_digest_mismatch, comparison_digest_mismatch and trusted_head_mismatch, each covered by a test.
A truncated tail fails verifyHistory only when a trusted head is supplied, and a test proves both cases.
All fixtures are synthetic, and npm run check passes.

out_of_scope: Live Collectors and Identity Binding config
Projections, Activity Calendar and Project Timeline
Any HOME API, MCP server or Scope enforcement
Real customer or account data; fixtures are synthetic
Merges, deploys and paid model spend without Danny's yes
